bio.text: Elissa Slotkin was elected to the U.S. Senate from Michigan in November 2024, succeeding Debbie Stabenow.
She is a former CIA analyst who served three tours in Iraq alongside the U.S. military, and later held national security roles at the Pentagon and White House.
She was elected to the U.S. House in 2018 and re-elected in 2020 and 2022.
